claude.sample_unit: All of Us Research Program participants

links.outcome: Fairness metrics and model performance after applying reweighing bias mitigation by gender and race
links.effect: Reweighing applied to the stacking algorithm improved fairness across racial and gender groups without compromising performance; AUC improved 0.90 to 0.95 with genetic data.
links.quote: The reweighing preprocessing technique applied to the stacking algorithm effectively improved the model's fairness across racial and gender groups without compromising performance.

unlisted_practices: Adding genomic data to EHR and wearable data to improve predictive performance
Using SHAP to identify top predictors
Applying the HEAAL framework to guide fair AI development
